items.source: Note: Classes annotated or meta-annotated with @Component will not be picked up by this annotation.
items.translation: 注意：使用 @Component 注解或元注解的类不会被此注解拾取。

items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute. Allows for more concise annotation declarations e.g.: @ConfigurationPropertiesScan("org.my.pkg") instead of @ConfigurationPropertiesScan(basePackages="org.my.pkg").
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。允许使用更简洁的注解声明，例如：`@ConfigurationPropertiesScan("org.my.pkg")` 而不是 `@ConfigurationPropertiesScan(basePackages="org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for configuration properties.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找配置属性的包的 basePackages() 的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: classes from the base packages to scan
items.translation: 要扫描的基础包中的类

items.source:
Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that
serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Base packages to scan for configuration properties.
items.translation: 要扫描配置属性的基础包。
